reviews.title: “Could not load track: Operation not permitted”
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app since 2021 and I loved it. This is a really nice software that lets you make really good music, but lately I’ve been going through a really bad issue: I’ve been getting a prompt on the screen very often that says “Could not load track: Operation not permitted” and I can’t load a track at all. The only way you could use the app is by force closing the app and open it back again, which is very impractical and annoying. I can’t load a track after another and sometimes I can’t even use the app. That error is happening repeatedly which interferes directly with using the app.

I’d like to get this error fixed as soon as possible. Like I said, I really love this app and I even pay a yearly subscription to use all features, but this problem will lead me to cancel the subscription and uninstall the app. Please address this issue as soon as possible. Thanks!

reviews.title: Used to be decent app before they stole my purchases
reviews.text:
I’m so sick of greedy subscription requiring developers but I’m more sick of devs that sell their apps for a one time purchase, only to later take away the critical features they always had, in order to sell an “upgrade” that you have to keep paying for monthly until the end of time, or you can’t afford it.

I’ve been using this app and promoting it since day one of public launch.  I bought djay, I bought djay 2, then djay 3, djay Pro, then djay Pro AI.   I bought each version on the Mac which understandably is a separate additional charge.  Then they started with the subscription BS and I paid monthly for years.  I was charged for two subscription s at the same time for a while (don’t ask me how that happens or why I was never refunded, idk)

After years of buying every version, paying full price for every upgrade even though I’d already bought lifetime access, I couldn’t afford to keep the subscription.  NOW THE APP HAS BEEN RENDERED UNUSABLE , even after they flat out admitted I had already paid. They promoted me to “purchase” a “FREE UPGRADE TO GET THE ESSENTIAL PRO FEATURES” but they don’t even give you back the basic features you had over a decade ago on iOS 10.  

Sadly, I won’t reward this greed, so I will have to find or build a new app to mix.
